title: Technician II Sensor and Equipment Verification Log
description: A verification log for sensor identity, representative placement, command-versus-response checks, independent measurements, safe operator boundaries, and maintenance handoff.
instructions: Record asset and sensor identifiers before comparing readings or control responses.
Separate controller command, measured physical response, and independent reference measurement.
Document any placement, calibration, maintenance, airflow, pressure, or access condition that affects interpretation.
Stop and escalate protected access, hazardous-energy, disassembly, or servicing tasks unless specifically authorized.
limitations: A controller command or alarm reset is not proof that physical performance is restored.
This log does not grant calibration, electrical, refrigeration, pressure-system, or hazardous-energy service authority.
